description: zs.netring.v1's frame record (core sections 7.6, 7.7; telemetry.v2; #1149 Z2): its untemplated readings, and its closed families flattened, one field each, named by the reading's template with / and . as _. Every field is optional: an owner writes a reading it does not have absent, never 0. A range and a resolution are the quantity's own bound where it has one, else a stated guess (examples/zk2/zensight/README.md, "Frames"). A counter's width holds its worst rate over 900 s, two keyframes apart at a frame a minute.
